sandbox.notes: Mercado Libre has no sandbox: 'We do not have a test environment or sandbox to run tests: we make it possible to use test users for verification directly in production.' Create up to 10 test users with POST https://api.mercadolibre.com/users/test_user {site_id} using a production access token, save their credentials at once (they cannot be listed later), and authorize the app as a test seller; test users only transact with other test users' listings and expire after a while.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: App ID of your application (developers.mercadolibre.com > My applications); sent as client_id in the token request body.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Secret Key of the same application; sent as client_secret in the token request body.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token (TG-...) from a one-time authorization-code consent by the seller's ADMIN account (valid 6 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new access token (6 h) and a new refresh token, and only the last one issued is accepted. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token. The state file is keyed by platform id, so it is shared with ecommerce_channels/mercado_libre: give each server its own PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR (or its own consent) so they never race on one single-use refresh token.

config_fields.name: seller_id
config_fields.help: Numeric Mercado Libre user id of the seller (the `id` returned by GET /users/me); used as the seller filter of the order search.

adapter.terms: Mercado Libre seller API (per-site marketplaces MLA, MLB, MLM ...); prices are in the item's currency_id major units.

me.note: GET /users/me returns the authorised user {id, nickname, site_id, country_id, ...}; its id is the seller_id config value.

get_product.note: GET /items/{item_id} (e.g. MLA1136716168) returns the item {id, title, price, currency_id, available_quantity, sold_quantity, status active|paused|closed|under_review, permalink, date_created, last_updated, ...}. The description lives at /items/{id}/description and is not fetched.

update_price.note: CHANGES THE LIVE PRICE: PUT /items/{item_id} {price} ('When item is active you can modify ... Price') in the item's own currency_id (major units, e.g. 1000 = ARS 1,000); `currency` is ignored. Items with variations price each variation separately (not mapped). Returns the updated item.

list_sales.note: GET /orders/search?seller={config seller_id}&order.date_created.from=`since` (ISO-8601)&sort=date_desc&offset&limit (page size 50): orders {id, status (paid, confirmed, cancelled ...), total_amount, currency_id, date_created, order_items[{item{id, title}, quantity, unit_price}], buyer{id}}. product_id / product_name are the FIRST order item; `product_id` input is not sent (no documented item filter). Buyer emails are not exposed.

not_offered.list_products: GET /users/{user_id}/items/search returns only item ids (results: ["MLA...", ...]) (https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/en_us/items-and-searches); names and prices need a second multiget call, which one adapter call cannot chain.
not_offered.create_product: POST /items needs category_id, listing_type_id, pictures and the category's required attributes; the vocabulary carries none of them (the listing guide https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/en_us/products-sync-listings covers editing existing items only).
not_offered.get_sales_stats: No revenue summary endpoint is documented; sales are individual orders (https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/en_us/manage-sales).
not_offered.list_refunds: The sales guide documents orders search and order detail only; no refunds list appears there (https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/en_us/manage-sales).
not_offered.refund: The sales guide documents no refund call for an order (https://developers.mercadolibre.com.ar/en_us/manage-sales); refunds run through Mercado Libre's claims / Mercado Pago flows, which this adapter does not map.

evidence: probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
token api.mercadolibre.com/oauth/token: 400 invalid client_id or client_secret
